LESSON: THE BIBLE BIBLE

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HOLY
Topic 2.1: The Bible BIBLE

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Bible BIBLE. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is a Bible?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify the bible as a Holy book used by Christians for his/her spiritual growth
2. Sing simple songs on the Bible as a Holy book of God to be respected
3. appreciate the Bible as a Holy book
4. desire to read the Bible as Holy book

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify the bible as a Holy book used by Christians for his/her spiritual growth
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the bible as a Holy book used by Christians for his/her spiritual growth. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Sing simple songs on the Bible as a Holy book of God to be respected
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sing simple songs on the Bible as a Holy book of God to be respected. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the Bible as a Holy book
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the Bible as a Holy book. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. desire to read the Bible as Holy book
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to desire to read the Bible as Holy book. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Bible BIBLE.
2. Explain The Bible BIBLE to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

1. Write five sentences about The Bible BIBLE. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
